title: Folsom State Prison Entrance
geometryBasis: Named prison site, mapped transverse entrance wall and approach cut, two exact public-domain Qualla photographs, and the original regional elevation.
sectionBasis: At the end of the approach, a projecting granite gateway with a broad vehicle arch and narrow pedestrian arch sits below a corbelled tower with a glazed octagonal room and flared green roof. Granite returns extend on either side.
limitations: The model covers the photographed entrance, green-roof tower and visible stretches of granite wall. The larger prison grounds, interior structures and other eras fall outside this scope.
Arch sizes, tower height and the far wall return have been estimated from the photographs and mapped approach. Plaques, signs and fixtures are simplified.
The original public terrain supplies context and approximate elevations.
